detailed_description:
The target video uses a photorealistic, live-action cinematic comedy style with natural daylighting, subtle character micro-expressions, gentle camera pans, and a warm playful tone, set on an imperial palace film set with high vermilion red walls topped with yellow glazed tiles and grey stone paving.
[Shot 1] The video opens with a medium shot showing <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> sitting side-by-side on wooden resting benches in the imperial palace film set, with high red palace walls in the background. <Subject 1> exhales lightly and relaxes her shoulders, setting her steel sword beside her after an intense combat take. <Subject 2> turns toward her holding the <Subject 3> graphics card, raising it like a street vendor displaying his finest goods, while a slow camera push-in builds anticipation.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, a medium close-up focuses on <Subject 2> as he grins with a salesmen's enthusiasm, tilting the <Subject 3> graphics card toward the camera so its fans and shroud catch the daylight, and speaks in a lively, persuasive tone, <d>[Chinese] 女侠留步！这块显卡性能拉满，4K 光追随便跑，今天给你特价，错过再等一年！</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:04.500, <Subject 2> gently hands the <Subject 3> graphics card over to <Subject 1> and continues in a warm, considerate pitch, <d>[Chinese] 你刚才那场打戏拍得多费劲，配台好机器才叫舒服，这卡静音又凉快，包你满意！</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, a close-up shot captures <Subject 1> looking down at the <Subject 3> graphics card in her hands; her tired expression softens into amused skepticism behind her glasses, one eyebrow rising as she answers softly with a teasing smile, <d>[Chinese] 你这汉服片场还卖显卡？行，插上亮个机给我看看，别是翻新卡。</d>
[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, a two-shot medium angle shows <Subject 1> holding the <Subject 3> graphics card in both hands with a satisfied smile while <Subject 2> gives a happy thumbs-up and laughs, as dappled daylight falls across the imperial palace film set.
